start: ^Junior Analyst: You're the one the Director brought in. Don't tell me anything. Knowing things is how you end up in an interview room.
^Junior Analyst: I've read the same threat feed six times tonight and couldn't tell you a word of it. Everyone's watching the door.

c-0: ^Junior Analyst: If I leave this desk, somebody writes down that I left this desk. I'll stay.
c-1: ^Junior Analyst: Close the door behind you. Please.
